result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It does not restrict Licensor/Vendor assignments, prohibit assignment to a Customer competitor, or provide a mutual successor-assignment right with notice. Licensee's affiliate right appears to apply only upon a Change of Control and conflicts with Section (c)'s continuing consent requirement. The obsolete deemed-reasonable consent language and incorrect cross-reference remain despite the margin comment. The phrase “provided the assignee agrees in writing to be bound by this Agreement to the consummation” is grammatically defective, leaving the clause internally inconsistent and commercially unclear.
